$comment: Performance budget for the public landing page, gated in CI by scripts/check-perf-budget.mjs. The mobile Lighthouse performance score of 82 is the owner-measured baseline recorded in the frontend audit sheet (row 35, 'Mobile perf 82 measured'). It is the only measured value in this file - do not add LCP/CLS/etc. thresholds until a real measurement exists for them. The hard floor is the measured score minus FLAKE_TOLERANCE_POINTS (gate policy, not a measurement): shared CI runners vary run to run, so a small tolerance avoids false failures while still catching real regressions. Scores between the floor and the measured baseline fail with a 'below budget' warning so drift is visible.

measuredBaseline.source: frontend audit sheet row 35 (owner-measured mobile Lighthouse score, 2026-11)
